title: The serpent and the young hero

plan.english: Grandfather, tell me a story! Let me tell you the story of the serpent, child. The serpent lay on the mountain, and it seized the waters. Did Perkʷunos strike it down? Perkʷunos did not strike it down; a young hero struck it down. Did he not grow afraid of the serpent? He did not grow afraid. He threw his spear, and the spear split the serpent's head. Where did the waters go? He released them, and they ran down from the mountain to the fields.

title: The fox and the wolf on the ice

plan.english: Mother, tell me a story about the fox! On the ice she was eating fish, and a hungry wolf caught sight of her. He asked her: 'Where did you take the fish?' Did she tell the truth? She did not tell the truth. She said: 'Put your tail into the hole in the ice!' And he put it in? Then his tail was freezing! You know the end! The tail froze, and he left it in the ice.

title: The night raid on the cattle

plan.english: Old man, tell me a story! Did you drive off the enemies' cattle? I drove them off, young man. Ten men went out at night. Did you not grow afraid? My heart trembled. Then we found the cows in a field. Did the herdsmen see you? A boy saw us, and they were sleeping. Then we drove a hundred cows to the village. What did the king give you? He gave me a bull and great fame.

title: The three brothers and the fire

plan.english: Master, tell me the story of the three brothers! Three brothers were seeking fire in the night. The oldest found a beast, and another found a bear. And the young one found the fire? He found it. An old woman was guarding the fire. Did she give it to him? He gave her his food, and she gave it to him. And the others? They returned home, and he warmed them.

title: The blood-price that was never paid

They owe it; let us speak with them, and let us not fight.
